## Summary

Fixes #96.

When GitHub runs out of hosted capacity (usually macOS arm64), it cancels a queued job with *"The job was not acquired by Runner of type hosted even after multiple attempts"*. That job has no runner and no steps, so no code ran. The release gate and Pipeline Status still saw a failed job, and nothing reran it.

### Root cause, and one correction to the suggested filter

The jobs API shows a not-acquired job as `conclusion: cancelled`, `runner_name: ""` and `steps: []` (links-notation run [41477660740](https://github.com/link-foundation/links-notation/actions/runs/41477660740/job/125389842236)). **This repository's own run [41299533544](https://github.com/link-foundation/csharp-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/actions/runs/41299533544/job/124827419102) has a `Detect Changes` job with exactly the same shape.** That job was cancelled by job-level concurrency while it was still queued. Only the check-run annotation tells the two cases apart:

| Job | conclusion | runner | steps | annotation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| links-notation `kotlin / ios` | cancelled | "" | 0 | `The job was not acquired by Runner of type hosted even after multiple attempts` |
| template `Detect Changes` | cancelled | "" | 0 | `Canceling since a higher priority waiting request for … exists` |

So a job counts as **unacquired** only if it has no runner, has no steps, **and** carries the not-acquired annotation. Both API payloads are committed as test fixtures under `scripts/fixtures/runner-acquisition/`.

### Changes

1. **`.github/workflows/rerun-infrastructure-failures.yml`** (new, `workflow_run` on `CI/CD Pipeline` / `completed`, `conclusion == 'failure'`). It runs `node scripts/runner-acquisition.mjs rerun`, which:
   - reads the run's latest attempt, its jobs, and the check-run annotations of runnerless jobs;
   - calls `POST …/rerun-failed-jobs` only when an unacquired job exists. That endpoint also reruns the skipped `release` and the failed `pipeline-status`, so both gates are re-evaluated;
   - reruns at most twice (attempts 2 and 3). On attempt 3 it fails red with `gh run rerun <id> --failed --repo …` instead of looping;
   - never reruns a job that ran and failed, a concurrency cancellation, a run that is not a completed failure, or a run superseded by a newer run of the same workflow, branch and event. Rerunning a superseded run would cancel the newer run's jobs through the job concurrency groups.
   - Security: it checks out only `github.sha` (the default branch for `workflow_run`) with `persist-credentials: false`. The only value it takes from the event is the numeric run id. Permissions are `actions: write` and `checks: read` at job level, `contents: read` everywhere else. The zizmor `dangerous-triggers` ignore carries this justification.
2. **`scripts/pipeline-gate.mjs` / Pipeline Status**: the verdict does not change. A gate with an unacquired job stays red because nothing was tested. It now also emits `::error title=Hosted runner not acquired::<jobs>. GitHub could not provide a runner; no code ran. rerun-infrastructure-failures.yml reruns these automatically.` The job gets `actions: read` and `checks: read`, and the step gets `GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}`. These API reads are diagnostic only: if they fail, the step prints a notice and the verdict is unaffected.
3. **Optional item 3 (opt-in):** `continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.os == 'macos-15' && vars.NON_BLOCKING_MACOS == 'true' }}` on the test job. By default every leg still blocks the release. When a maintainer sets `NON_BLOCKING_MACOS=true`, a failing macOS leg no longer blocks. Because `needs.test.result` then reads `success`, Pipeline Status adds its own visible `::warning title=Non-blocking job did not succeed::…` annotation, as the issue asks.
4. README section "Jobs that never get a hosted runner", changeset, and `experiments/issue-96/dry-run-rerun.mjs` for read-only checks against real runs.

### Reproduce / verify

- **Offline tests:**
  - `bun test scripts/runner-acquisition.test.mjs scripts/rerun-workflow-policy.test.mjs scripts/pipeline-gate.test.mjs` uses the real fixtures. It covers: the unacquired job is rerun; real test failures, concurrency cancellations and superseded runs are not rerun; rerun on attempts 1–2, give up on attempt 3; dry run; input validation; pagination; the gate's error and warning annotations.
  - The policy test pins the trigger to `release.yml`'s exact `name`, the permissions, the trusted checkout, the event values used, and the default-blocking macOS leg.
- **Live, read-only:**
  - `GH_TOKEN=$(gh auth token) node experiments/issue-96/dry-run-rerun.mjs link-foundation/links-notation 41477660740` prints `attempt 1: 83 jobs, unacquired: kotlin / ios`. The decision is `nothing`, because run 41507075196 superseded it.
  - The same command on this repository's run `41299533544` prints `unacquired: none`, so the concurrency cancellation is not misclassified.
- **Gate CLI against the real run** (`NEEDS_JSON` with `test: cancelled`, `GITHUB_RUN_ID=41477660740`): it prints `::error title=Hosted runner not acquired::kotlin / ios. …` and still exits 1.
- **Linters:** `bun run check` passes. actionlint 1.7.12 (digest-pinned image) and zizmor 1.29.0, both the regular and the pedantic high/high pass, report no findings.

### Limits

- GitHub reads `workflow_run` workflows only from the default branch, so the rerun workflow cannot fire on this PR. It starts working once merged. Its logic is covered by the offline tests and the live dry run above.
- I could not confirm whether GitHub applies job-level `continue-on-error` to a job that never got a runner. If it does not, the opt-in still covers legs that ran and failed, and the automatic rerun covers unacquired legs.
- Locally, 2 tests in `validate-nuget-package.test.mjs` fail because this machine has .NET SDK 10.0.112 and `global.json` pins 10.0.403. They fail the same way on an unmodified checkout, and CI installs the pinned SDK.
title: Rerun CI jobs that GitHub never handed to a hosted runner

## Summary

Fixes #93

Brings every ecosystem up to date and turns `main` CI green again after the Dependabot merges in #84, #85 and #90. The full analysis, the before/latest/after tables from the registries, and the CI logs are in [`dev/log/issues/93/pulls/94/`](https://github.com/link-foundation/csharp-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/tree/issue-93-75ce99e6d6e2/dev/log/issues/93/pulls/94).

### Why `main` was red (root cause)
`security-workflow-policy`, `release-workflow-policy` and `workflow-injection-policy` tests hard-coded the **previous** commit SHAs of `actions/checkout`, `actions/setup-dotnet` and `zizmorcore/zizmor-action`. Every Dependabot bump broke **Helper Checks** and **Lint and Format Check**. The merges stay as they are. The new `scripts/action-pins.mjs` (with tests) checks two rules instead:
- every `uses:` points to a 40-hex SHA with a version comment
- each action uses a single SHA across all workflows and the composite action

The tests no longer contain SHAs that Dependabot would have to keep in sync.

The two other `main` failures, `Check Codecov token` and `Release Preflight` (publishing identity is still a template placeholder), are human-action gates by design. They pass on PRs and fail on `main` with an explicit message. To clear them, the owner needs to set `CODECOV_TOKEN` and choose a real `PackageId`/`Authors`.

### Changes
- **JavaScript (bun):** `@types/node` 22→26, `eslint` 10.14.0, `typescript` 6→**7** (its stricter JSDoc checking needed real `@param` types), `minimatch` override 11.0.3. `bun.lock` regenerated.
- **.NET:** `net8.0` → **`net10.0`** (current LTS; .NET 8 support ends 2026-11-10).
  - The SDK is now pinned once in `global.json` and read by `setup-dotnet` (`global-json-file`), replacing 8 `dotnet-version: '8.0.x'` pins.
  - Removed MSBuild properties that 3 csproj files duplicated from `Directory.Build.props`.
  - All 3 lockfiles regenerated.
- **xUnit:** `xunit` 2.9.2 → **`xunit.v3.mtp-off` 4.0.2**. This supersedes #88; Dependabot closes #88 once `xunit` is gone.
  - `mtp-off` keeps VSTest, so `Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk`, `xunit.runner.visualstudio`, `coverlet.collector` (from #86/#87/#89) and the Codecov collection keep working.
  - Adopted analyzer rule xUnit1051 (`TestContext.Current.CancellationToken`).
- **Example:** `examples/BasicUsage` already failed to build on `main` (14 analyzer errors) and CI never built it. It now builds and is in the solution, so CI covers it.
- **GitHub Actions:** every action is on its newest release (resolved via `gh api`, see `latest-actions.txt`).
- **pre-commit:** `pre-commit-hooks` v5.0.0 → v6.0.0. The hooks v6 removed are not used here.
- **Dependabot:** now covers `bun` (was `npm`), `nuget` in all 4 directories, `dotnet-sdk`, the composite action, and `pre-commit`.

### Left behind (with reason)
- `Microsoft.Bcl.AsyncInterfaces` stays at 6.0.0 (transitive). xunit.v3 sets that floor, and on net10.0 the type is built in, so the polyfill is never used at runtime.
